asc_inceleme_notu_en: Version 1.73: new Social tab (friends + clubs). Clubs are joined with a 6-letter invite code. Move Log Pro is a ONE-TIME non-consumable in-app purchase (com.nickdegs.kisisel.pro, no subscription) that unlocks joint ride videos: when friends or club members ride together, a joint 3D video is generated on the device. Everything else is free. Purchase and Restore Purchases are in Profile > Move Log Pro (also Social > Group ride). Sign in with Apple to test.
